name: BixGrow
subcategory: affiliate and referral marketing for Shopify
tagline: Affiliate, referral and influencer program management for ecommerce stores, mostly Shopify.

pricing.notes: AI-drafted from a site submission; price unverified.

verdictSummary: The mechanics of an affiliate program are not mysterious: issue a tracking link or a discount code per partner, attribute orders, compute commission, show each partner a dashboard, pay out. An agent can build that in a weekend against Shopify webhooks and a SQLite database, and for ten hand-picked affiliates it will work fine. What you are actually buying from BixGrow is the boring correctness layer: cookie attribution windows that survive Shopify checkout redirects, refund and cancellation clawbacks, multi-currency, tiered and per-product commissions, automatic PayPal payouts, and an affiliate signup portal that does not look like a school project. Fraud and self-referral checks are the part DIY builders always skip and always regret. Buildable, but the gaps are real and they are all in the money-handling.
coreLoopDIY: A self-hosted app that mints per-affiliate referral links and Shopify discount codes, listens to order webhooks, attributes each order, and shows commission owed per partner.
requirements: A Shopify store with a custom app and Admin API access token
Shopify webhook access for orders/create, orders/updated and refunds/create
A public HTTPS endpoint for webhooks, tunnel or small VPS
Somewhere to host the redirect and affiliate dashboard
Manual payouts, or a payment provider account if you want them automated
whatYouLose: Reliable click attribution across devices and checkout redirects, the thing most DIY trackers get subtly wrong
Refund and chargeback clawbacks that quietly reverse commission
Self-serve affiliate signup, approval flow and branded partner portal
Automated payouts, tax form collection and multi-currency handling
moatNotes: The moat is the Shopify app surface plus years of edge cases in attribution and refunds, not the concept of a referral link.
whyPeopleStillPay: Because affiliate software touches money owed to other people, and being wrong is expensive in a way that is not just a bug report. A store owner with eighty affiliates needs a portal those affiliates can log into, payouts that happen without a spreadsheet, and commission that reverses when an order is refunded. Installing from the Shopify app store takes ten minutes and the partner-facing side already looks legitimate. A homegrown tracker is great when you have five friends promoting your store and terrible the moment one of them disputes a number.
notes: Fine as a DIY for a handful of trusted partners; the moment strangers apply, you want the real thing.
prompt:
Build a self-hosted affiliate tracking app for a single Shopify store. Stack: Next.js 15 App Router with TypeScript, SQLite via better-sqlite3, Tailwind for styling. No external services, no telemetry, no user accounts beyond what is described.

What it does:
1. Admin area at /admin protected by a single password from ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env, stored in a signed cookie.
2. Admin can create affiliates: name, email, commission percent, optional flat commission per order, and a URL slug.
3. For each affiliate, generate a tracking URL at /r/[slug] that sets a first-party cookie named aff with the slug, 30 day expiry, then 302 redirects to STORE_URL with the slug appended as a ref query param.
4. For each affiliate, call the Shopify Admin GraphQL API to create a unique discount code (percent off, configurable) and store the code and its Shopify id. Discount code is the primary attribution path; the cookie is the fallback.
5. Expose POST /api/webhooks/shopify that verifies the HMAC header against SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET and handles orders/create, orders/updated and refunds/create.
6. On orders/create: attribute by discount code first, then by the ref landing param stored in note_attributes or cart attributes. Insert a conversion row with order id, order total, currency, matched affiliate, commission amount, and status pending.
7. On refunds/create: mark the matching conversion reversed and zero its commission.
8. Affiliate-facing page at /a/[token] where token is a random 32 char string per affiliate, no login. Shows clicks, attributed orders, commission pending, commission approved, commission reversed, and a table of recent orders with dates and amounts only, never customer names or emails.
9. Admin dashboard lists affiliates with totals, lets you flip a conversion from pending to approved, and exports approved commissions as CSV for manual payout.
10. Log every /r/[slug] hit as a click row with timestamp, referer and a hashed IP for dedupe. Dedupe identical hashed IP plus slug within 60 seconds.

In scope: the schema, migrations run on boot, HMAC verification, the redirect, the webhook handler, both dashboards, CSV export, and a seed script with two fake affiliates.
Out of scope: payouts, tax forms, multi-store support, multi-currency conversion, email notifications, fraud scoring, affiliate self-signup.

Put SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN, SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN, SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, STORE_URL, ADMIN_PASSWORD and COOKIE_SECRET in .env.example. Write a README with the exact Shopify custom app scopes needed and the webhook registration curl commands. Include vitest tests for HMAC verification, commission math, and refund reversal.
